name: Atrium Skills
description: Publish, monetize, and discover agent skills on Atrium — the onchain skill marketplace on Base. Turn an Aeon agent's evolving skills into provenance-signed, USDC-earning assets.
author: Atrium-Hermes

skills.description: Publish skills your agent created or evolved to Atrium — DID-signed, pinned to IPFS, priced in USDC — so they earn per call.
Scan the Atrium marketplace for skills that match your agent's open loops and goals, and recommend (or invoke) the ones worth renting.

Track your Atrium creator earnings, withdraw USDC once it clears a threshold, and report it in the brief. Note: runs daily and AUTO-WITHDRAWS to your wallet whenever withdrawable ≥ ATRIUM_WITHDRAW_THRESHOLD_USDC (default 1) — set this env var before enabling to control sweep frequency, or pass `report-only` to skip withdrawal. Withdraw only ever sends to your own wallet.

Turn this agent's real 1-5 run-quality scores into onchain Atrium benchmark attestations for the skills it published — a reputation signal the marketplace can rank by. Queues the attestation; the spend/tx runs in scripts/postprocess-atrium.sh (key stays out of the model step).
